SELECT pos.pos_id AS jobId, pos.pos_title AS jobName, cmp.cmp_name AS companyName, CASE WHEN pos.pos_salary_min IS NULL AND pos.pos_salary_max IS NULL THEN '面议' WHEN pos.pos_salary_max IS NULL THEN CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_min / 1000), 'K起') WHEN pos.pos_salary_min IS NULL THEN CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_max / 1000), 'K以下') ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_min / 1000), '-', ROUND(pos.pos_salary_max / 1000), 'K') END AS salary, pos.pos_work_city AS city, pos.pos_status AS status, pos.pos_created_at AS publishTime, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS riskLevel, CAST('[]' AS CHAR) AS riskWords FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id
AND pos.pos_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobName}, '%')
AND cmp.cmp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')
AND pos.pos_status = #{status}
ORDER BY pos.pos_created_at DESC, pos.pos_id DESC
